summary: Modular electric and gas specialty vans with integrated fleet-control software.
editor_note: The vehicle starts as a configurable operating platform rather than a finished RV floor plan. Grounded combines modular interiors for clinics, field service, food, outreach, and camping with batteries, Starlink, and Grounded+ fleet controls. That makes the software, power system, and physical build one deployment surface. The open test is whether customization economics and service capacity hold as fleets move beyond one-off builds.

product_evidence.claim: Grounded presents modular specialty-vehicle layouts for mobile health, field services, food, outreach, command, and camping missions.
Grounded+ connects battery, climate, location, and fleet controls through the vehicle's integrated software layer.

market_context.primary_user: Organizations deploying mobile clinics, field-service fleets, outreach vehicles, and compact recreational vehicles.
market_context.differentiation: A modular physical build is paired with onboard power, connectivity, and fleet software instead of being delivered as an isolated custom conversion.
market_context.why_now: The Seed round arrives as operators want mobile facilities without committing every mission to a bespoke vehicle architecture.

risks.claim: Customization cost, delivery time, and service capacity may become harder to control as fleet configurations diversify.
risks.basis: The official surface demonstrates a wide modular catalog, but does not publish fleet-scale delivery or maintenance economics.
